Job Description:  
 We want somebody with C# experience, but focused on back-end development (Web API, WCF, etc.) with a strong grasp of RESTful API’s. This is a case where domain experience (e.g. REST) is more important than language. If push comes to shove, a good Java or Python person with a little bit of C# / .net experience will be acceptable. 
 Must Have:
 1. C#.Net
 2. Web API
 3. WCF
 4. RESTful API’s
 

 Must Have Business Qualifications: 
 Good Communication Skills. 
 Self starter who can independently complete assigned tasks without the need for follow ups. 
 Get it done attitude, and takes pride in delivering superior quality work on schedule.
